title: Should I change my Game name?
author: Guildbound
selftext:
Recently found out someone already released a game on Steam using “GuildBound” should I just change the name or add : Idle RPG. Funny thing is we both idle games. 

Is this AI pushing the generic names to users ?

Any advice ?

comments.author: Key-Media-6395
comments.body: Guildbound is pretty generic, imo. Even if the other game didn't exist i'd suggest you change it

replies.author: Guildbound
replies.body:
Have been seeing a lot of “bound” games lately 

Damn…. Now time to find a new name :( help

replies.author: Key-Media-6395
replies.body: i dont know enough about your game sorry

replies.author: Guildbound
replies.body: Damn! lol 🤣 I used GuildBound because theirs 3 “guilds” to choose from with different recipes…. Might just add the :Idle Rpg

replies.author: PM_Me_Those_
replies.body: This is what game stores will kinda become as AI becomes better and better, unfortunately. Hard to stand out sometimes.

replies.author: Guildbound
replies.body: Yeah been seeing a lot of names that were once recommended to me by my AI on Steam already releasing

comments.author: Another_3
comments.body: Bond seems to be another overused name.

replies.author: Guildbound
replies.body: Lol 🤣 yup I was working on another project and wanted to use “spellbond” or “spellbound” I’m like no!!

comments.author: CashFirm573
comments.body: Why wouldn't you change it and how shit is you're game to have AI pick the name as well? here we go AI Slop.

replies.author: Guildbound
replies.body: You’re ? Learn how to properly spell first lol it’s “your game” and yes I thought by giving AI details about my game it would give me a nice name…. I even said check steam make sure that game doesn’t exist and it didn’t until now 🤣🤣🤣

comments.author: jimbojohndoe
comments.body: I just noticed my game is generic naming as well with "Bound". I really don't want to change my name either haha.
